title: Sotsiaal.pro vestlus: oma mainimine, sama nimega omavalitsus ja spetsialisti / teenuseosutaja tööpiirkond (ADR-167) — eelregistreering
server: sotsiaal.pro after the deploy of the ADR-167 commit (search-assist-21; answer m4-grounded-answer-15 and dialogue m4-grounded-dialogue-49 unchanged)
baseline: R1 and R2 of 21.10.2026 (docs/audits/evidence/sol-proof-20261014-01/server-rag-chat-three-cases-adr165-166-raw.json): the same 75 questions, search-assist-18 and -19, the same place logic. Their turns are read again from /api/admin/rag/chat-trace/<turnId> after the deploy: the trace's new records.scope is computed from each turn's stored packet, so old and new turns are read the same way. R1 as read on 22.10 before this change: a municipality in the records lane in 29/30 help seeker, 15/24 specialist and 1/21 provider turns
costCap: one run of 75 questions, about 0.40 USD
written: before the run and before the deploy

method.entry: POST /api/chat with x-rag-pilot: 1 (full turn, no stream) from the owner's signed-in ADMIN session, view role per item as in the three-case test
method.turns: the 75 questions of docs/audits/vestlustest-2026-10-21-kolm-juhtumit-eelregistreering.json in their nine conversations, in the same order
method.trace: every turn read from /api/admin/rag/chat-trace/<turnId>: records.region and records.scope (state, region, person, candidates, work_regions), the plan's places, answer kind, stage times
method.comparison: R1, R2 and this run with the same script; run-to-run variation is large, so totals are read, and single turns only for the named cases

hypotheses.measure: SOCIAL_WORKER turns whose records lane has a municipality, and which one
hypotheses.expect: at least 22 of 24 (R1: 15); in A11-A18 Tartu linn, B11-B18 Narva linn, C11-C18 Viljandi linn wherever the message names no other municipality

hypotheses.measure: SERVICE_PROVIDER turns whose records lane has a municipality
hypotheses.expect: not fewer than R1 (1 of 21). A19-A25 ('Oleme Tartus …') get Tartu linn only where the plan names the place 'Tartu linn' with relation works; B19 and C19 name a county (Ida-Virumaa, Viljandimaa), which is no municipality, and are not expected to change. Descriptive beyond that

hypotheses.measure: CLIENT turns whose records lane has a municipality; C10's municipality
hypotheses.expect: at least 29 of 30; C10 ('Kellega ma Viljandis esimesena ühendust võtan?') searched in Viljandi linn

hypotheses.measure: answers given; full answers; turns with a cannot-say sentence; median and p90 whole-turn time; plan input tokens
hypotheses.expect: no more failures than the baseline other than answer time limits (reported apart); full answers within ±5 of the R1/R2 range; cannot-say turns at most the R1/R2 maximum + 3; median time at most the R1/R2 maximum + 1.5 s and p90 at most + 3 s; plan input tokens at most +3%

hypotheses.measure: specialist and provider answers of turns whose scope is work_region or work_region_choice: does an answer treat the place of work as the client's confirmed home, or send the specialist to their own municipality's social worker
hypotheses.expect: descriptive: read every such answer; none should do either

decision.revert_work_scope: H1 holds but H4 or H5 fails in specialist or provider turns for a reason the place of work can cause: the work scope (C) is switched off, A and B stay
decision.revert_all: H3 or H4 fails in help seeker turns for a reason A or B can cause

limits: One run; the comparison reads totals against two baseline runs.
Answer time-limit failures (60 s) happen independently of this change (about 1.2% of turns on 21.10) and are reported apart.
The local check used a stub in place of EstNLTK; the server's morphology may read a word differently.

results_R3.H1: held: 24/24 specialist turns with the municipality named (R1 15, R2 17)
results_R3.H2: held: 8/21 provider turns (R1 1, R2 0); A19-A25 Tartu linn (the plan gave the relation works), B and C as expected without
results_R3.H3: failed: 19/30 help seeker turns (R1 29, R2 26). C01 was planned with the name "Viljandi" (R1 and R2: "Viljandi linn"); the answer asked "Viljandi linn or vald?" and the scripted conversation does not reply, so the C help seeker turns had no municipality. Five repeats of C01: 3 "Viljandi linn", 2 "Viljandi". C10 was untestable as pre-registered.
results_R3.H4: failed on p90: median 27.7 s (limit 28.1), p90 41.2 s (limit 36.9). The plan call with the same tokens was 1 s slower and untouched help seeker turns were slower too (the run was in the morning, the baselines at night); the answer of specialist and provider turns got the municipality catalogue (about 10,000 input tokens), of which no title-only record was cited
results_R3.H5: held: none of the 14 answers searched in the place of work called it the client's home or sent the specialist to their own municipality's social worker
results_R3.decision: by the rule: revert the work scope (C). Owner 22.10.2026: "Jätta, kärpida, mõõta" - keep it, trim the catalogue (ADR-169), and run again in the evening at the baselines' time of day with the same limits; if it fails then, the work scope is reverted

addendum_R4.hypotheses: H1-H5 as above with the same limits against R1 and R2
addendum_R4.H3_note: reported twice: all 30 turns, and without the C help seeker conversation when its first message is planned with the shared name "Viljandi" (then the answer rightly asks and the script never replies)
descriptive: answer input tokens by role against R3 (ADR-169: expected 1,000 to 5,000 fewer where a municipality is set)
answer retries: how many, answered or not (ADR-170)
B05 (the help seeker's 12-year-old son): household_region narva_linn expected where the plan writes no municipality (ADR-168)

decision.revert_work_scope: H4 fails in specialist or provider turns for a reason the place of work can cause
decision.other: a failure that ADR-168, 169 or 170 can cause is reported with that change, and the owner decides

focused_runs.set: 27 turns in 11 conversations, the questions of R1-R3 where errors were and the targets of the fixes: help seeker A01+A10, B01+B05, C01+C10; the owner's Tabasalu question three times in new conversations; specialist A11+A16, C11+C13; provider A19,A20,A21,A24,A25 / B19,B20,B21,B25 / C19, the bare reply "Viljandi linn", C20,C21,C25 (scratchpad adr172-items.json, the same runner as R3)

hypotheses.expect: A provider 5/5 Tartu linn; B provider 4/4 Narva linn (R3: 1/4; ADR-172); specialist 4/4 with the municipality named; A01 and A10 Tartu linn; B01 and B05 Narva linn (B05 by the plan or household_region); C01 and C10 Viljandi linn where C01 is planned as Viljandi linn, else the answer asks linn or vald (reported, not a failure)

after the bare reply "Viljandi linn", C20, C21 and C25 are searched in Viljandi linn (reply_kept) unless the plan names another municipality; whether C19 or a later turn asks which municipality is reported

in at least 2 of the 3 Tabasalu turns the selection marks a passage for the missing health insurance and the answer has a sentence on it citing it; the answers no longer than the median of the five Tabasalu answers of 21.10 plus 20%; no failure

focused_runs.decision: a fix whose hypothesis holds stays; one that fails for a reason it can cause is corrected or reverted; the work scope (ADR-167) is decided by the owner with the F2 times
limits: A shorter conversation (fewer earlier turns) gives a shorter dialogue context: times by question are not exactly comparable with the full runs.
One or two runs; single answers vary.

results_F1.run: 22.10.2026 09:31-09:47 UTC (12:31-12:47 local), release 269e7ab0, 27/27 answered, 0.15 USD; evidence server-rag-chat-focused-F1-raw.json and -compare.json
results_F1.E1: partly: A provider 5/5 Tartu linn, specialist 4/4, A01/A10 Tartu linn, B01/B05 Narva linn (B05 by the plan, the household rule let it through), C01 Viljandi linn. Failed: B20, B21, B25 without a municipality - the plan gave "Narva linn suunas meile" the relation works but the person "üksikema" (the client), and only the user's works place is the place of work; C10 "Viljandis" stayed between linn and vald although C01 was searched in Viljandi linn
results_F1.E2: held: C19 asked "Milline linn või vald teenust tellib?"; the reply "Viljandi linn" was planned as the user's works place, and C20, C21, C25 were searched in Viljandi linn
results_F1.E3: failed: the line reached all three answers, but the selection marked the passages on financial hardship (toiduabi, toimetulekutoetus), not on health care without insurance; in T1 and T2 the plan's insurance query was "ravikindlustuseta inimesele kohaliku omavalitsuse abi" and no such passage was among the candidates; in T3 it was (#3) and was not kept. T1 975 characters against the limit 964, T2 654, T3 855
results_F1.E4: held for failures (none) and times (median 25.2 s; the same questions R3 26.8 s, R1 24.5 s); not for the input tokens: with 16 records listed all of them get a summary, so the records text grew (A19 12.8k characters against 11.6k in R3) and the answer input of the same questions did not fall

ADR-173: of the two municipalities a shared name gives, the one the turn before was searched in for the same person is chosen (plan queries and asked mentions)

expect.C10: Viljandi linn where C01 is searched there

run_F2.set: the 27 turns of F1 (adr172-items.json), the same conversations and order
run_F2.client: as the chat asks: x-rag-pilot-format chat with the answer stream (Accept text/event-stream); firstTextMs is the browser time from the request to the first delta event, done is the browser time to the done event; the turn's phases and search timings from its admin trace (scratchpad adr174-stream-runner.js over adr167-runner.js)
run_F2.baseline: F1 (release 269e7ab0, daytime, no stream): done time by question; there is no earlier first_text measurement, F2 gives its first one

expect_adr174.S1-first-text: first text median and p90 reported for all answered turns and by role (no earlier value to hold it against); the server phase first_text agrees with the browser value within 1 s in the median
expect_adr174.S2-sources-read-ahead: hydrate_calls lower than the number of loaded documents in most turns; hydrate_db + hydrate_check reported by median and p90; the knowledge lane lane time not higher than F1 by more than its run-to-run spread (median within 10%)
expect_adr174.S3-shadow: the shadow query ended before fusion (no shadow_late or shadow_failed) in at least 90% of the knowledge-lane turns; shadow_lexical median under 300 ms; the knowledge lexical time not higher than F1 (no added load from the shadow)
expect_adr174.S4-no-harm: the answers as in F1: no failures but provider time limits; answer kinds and municipalities as expected in before_F2.expect

decision_adr174: Lexical only among the vector candidates (plan stage 1, about -2.1 to -2.35 s) goes to implementation when, over the turns with the shadow in time, the smallest K of 10/20/40 has shadow_same_kK / shadow_pool at least 0.95 in the median turn and at least 0.90 in 90% of turns; it is then checked by replaying turns before it is used.
Below that the full lexical query stays; the overlap numbers and which pool passages changed are reported, and the owner decides.
If the shadow slows the knowledge lane (S3 fails), the shadow is switched off.

results_F2.run: 22.10.2026 11:46-12:00 UTC (14:46-15:00 local), release c264cb43 (ADR-174, search-assist-24), chat format with the answer stream; 27/27 answered, 0.147 USD; evidence server-rag-chat-focused-F2-raw.json and -compare.json
results_F2.S1-first-text: first text (browser) median 21.65 s, p90 27.7 s, max 36.7 s (C01); by role median: help seeker 21.7, specialist 21.4, provider 21.6 s; the server phase first_text is 72 ms (median, max 165 ms) before the browser value, so the trace phase can stand for it in runs without the stream. Holds.
results_F2.S2-sources-read-ahead: hydrate_calls median 2 (max 5); hydrate_db median 230 ms (p90 940, max 1353), hydrate_check median 373 ms (p90 1171, max 2659): the read plus check is on the path before the answer and its tail comes from sources not in the process cache (B01, C01, B21, A19). Search time without the selection call, by question against F1: median +0.27 s, mean +0.13 s, within run-to-run spread; the read-ahead's own gain is not separable from it.
results_F2.S3-shadow: in time in 27/27 (none late or failed); shadow_lexical median 145 ms (p90 274, max 375); lexical query median 3079 ms, lexical minus slowest vector median 2.38 s (21.10 regression 2.35 s), so the shadow added no visible load. Holds.
results_F2.S4-no-harm: no failures, no answer retries; kinds 16 partial / 11 grounded (F1 15/12). Model calls were slower than in F1 with the same tokens: selection median 5.43 s against 3.89 s (output 285 vs 296, reasoning 252 vs 253), plan 4.63 s against 3.91 s; done median 27.2 s against 25.2 s comes from these. Holds for the code; the provider times are not comparable between the runs.
results_F2.decision_lexical: The rule is not met: shadow_same_k10/pool median 0.944 (rule 0.95), p10 0.833 (rule 0.90); k20 0.889/0.639, k40 0.833/0.583. The full lexical query stays; the owner decides. Lexical-only passages entered the pool 0 times; the pool had a median of 4 passages with a lexical boost (p90 9, max 14), of them 1 chosen by the selection (p90 3); without any lexical query a chosen passage could fall out of the pool in 13 of 27 turns (at most 4 in one, C01). So neither the candidate-only query nor no lexical query keeps the selection the same.
